description: This file provides a media understanding provider implementation for Qwen, including functions to describe videos, resolve base URLs, and build provider objects. It handles API requests, response parsing, and configuration resolution.

methods.name: resolveQwenStandardBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the base URL for Qwen services based on configuration and provider ID.

methods.name: coerceQwenText
methods.description: Extracts and formats text content from Qwen video payload responses.

methods.name: describeQwenVideo
methods.description: Sends a request to describe a video using Qwen API and processes the response.

methods.name: buildQwenMediaUnderstandingProvider
methods.description: Constructs a media understanding provider object with capabilities and methods.

methods.name: resolveQwenMediaUnderstandingBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the base URL for Qwen media understanding services.
